title: Orochia : le pas
logline: A shy flamingo finally lands her dance move in an empty parking garage and shares it; the pigeon carries it across the night city, and everyone who sees it dances it — until a coin flies back to her.
theme: Share what you make, and the city moves with you.
style: Cinematic film still, stylized 3D animated feature film, real-world light and lenses, volumetric light, shallow depth of field, filmic contrast, fine grain, no lens flare rainbows. Violet and magenta light accents.
keep: One single continuous shot. The characters keep their exact cartoon design, proportions, colours and features, rendered as high-end feature-film CG characters with soft fine feather texture, lit by the scene's own light, with real contact shadows where they touch a surface. Plain unbranded surfaces, no lettering.
keyframeKeep: Keep every character's exact shape, proportions, colours, eyes and features, rendered as soft 3D feature-film CG characters with volumetric shading, lit by the same light as the scene, real contact shadows on the surface they stand on. No text, no logos, no people.

shots.motion: Push-in: the sky-blue pigeon swoops in and drops a small golden coin into the pink flamingo's open wing with a little bounce; she looks at it, then at the pigeon, and breaks into a huge grin. Violet ring light from the right. 50 mm.

shots.purpose: The resolve: she does the move once more, sure of herself, as the camera rises and the garage lights come on level by level.
shots.action: the flamingo hits her dance once more with total confidence, the pigeon beside her copies the heel click, then they both bow as the garage lights flicker on
shots.intent: the flamingo keeps making and sharing her dance, and the pigeon delivers it
shots.gaze: at each other, then up, proud
shots.physics: a clean spin, two heel clicks, a bow
shots.lighting: violet ring light from the right, garage lights coming on
shots.plate: High angle over an underground parking garage at night, wet concrete floor, a ring light glowing violet on the right casting long shadows to the left, a taped X, pillars, rows of ceiling lights. Violet and magenta light accents. No text, no signs with lettering, no screens with interface.
shots.keyframe: The flamingo on a taped X in a parking garage seen from above, mid-spin, the pigeon beside her, a violet ring light on the right.
shots.motion: High angle pulling back and up: the pink flamingo hits her dance once more — a sharp wing wave, a spin on one leg and a heel click with both wings thrown up — the sky-blue pigeon beside her copies the heel click, then they both bow as the rows of garage lights flicker on. 24 mm.

staging.surface: the wet concrete floor on the taped X

shots.purpose: The resolve: the empty garage glows violet as the camera rises through the levels; the title appears.
shots.action: the camera rises through the levels of the garage as the ring light pulses violet below, then the ceiling lights glow magenta
shots.lighting: violet ring light, magenta glow
shots.plate: High angle over the levels of an empty underground parking garage at night, a small ring light glowing violet far below on wet concrete, rows of ceiling lights glowing magenta, haze. Violet and magenta light accents. No text, no signs with lettering, no screens with interface.
shots.motion: Slow crane up through the levels of an empty parking garage, a ring light pulsing violet far below on wet concrete, the rows of ceiling lights glowing magenta in the haze. 24 mm.
